subject: Forecast stability advisory: pricing gate items needing commit
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast stability advisory: pricing gate items needing commit

Team —

Quick note ahead of next week's forecast lock: we have three material line items in the discount queue tied to GreenBridge (deal GB-2027-0892) that are still pending deal-desk approval. Finance flagged a potential downside to our committed Q3 revenue if these aren't resolved by Monday 6/7.

Ask: can each owner confirm stage + expected signed date (or clear blocker) by EOD Monday? I want to consolidate for the forecast call and mark anything we can't reasonably expect to commit.

Key items I pulled from the queue:
- Pricing approval (30% discount requested) — awaiting deal-desk rationale
- SOW signoff — procurement questions outstanding from GreenBridge
- Billing terms (net-60 vs net-30) — finance needs final position

Attachments: pricing_approval_form.xlsx (for deal-desk inputs), GreenBridge_SOW_v1.pdf (their requested SOW).

I'll pull together a short memo to finance with the final commit recommendation once I have updates.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast stability advisory: pricing gate items needing commit

Jordan —

Thanks for the ping. Quick updates from customer-facing side:
- GreenBridge is enthusiastic about a pilot and wants to move quickly, but they're pressing on price. The AE asked for 30% off list for the first 6 months to align with their pilot KPIs.
- SOW: they've returned a redlined copy with two scheduling constraints (start 7/15) and a request to include a success metric clause. See attached SOW v1 redlines.
- Timeline: the customer expects a final quote by 6/10 to lock resource planning.

My recommendation: we can compromise to 20% for the pilot with a strict QPU and renewal pricing floor — but that needs deal-desk signoff and a finance confirmation on revenue recognition given the pilot discount. If we can't get that by Monday, mark as 'at-risk' for Q3 commit.

I'll sync with the AE tonight and push for confirmation.

-Vanessa
Head of Account Management
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forecast stability advisory: pricing gate items needing commit

Folks —

Thanks for the context. Deal Desk position: we need a one-paragraph business rationale from the AE explaining the lift and strategic value of the pilot, and a renewal guardrail (i.e., minimum renewal price or % uplift after pilot). Without the rationale we cannot approve 30% off; 20% could be approved conditionally if finance signs off on revenue recognition treatment.

I've attached the pricing_approval_form.xlsx filled with conditional paths. Vanessa, can you get the AE to complete the "business impact" section and confirm renewal expectations? Once I have that and finance weighs in on the net-terms, I can issue an approval ticket.

Karthik
Senior Deal Desk Analyst
Redwood Inference

Cc: finance@greenbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing and SOW questions for Redwood pilot

Hi Vanessa / Jordan —

Apologies for the slow reply; finance needed to run this internally. Quick answers:
- We're willing to proceed with a 6-month pilot at 20% off list if Redwood can guarantee dedicated support for ramp weeks 1–4 and a post-pilot review to set renewal pricing.
- Billing terms: GreenBridge prefers net-30 but is open to net-45 with an early-pay credit if Redwood requires it for revenue timing.
- SOW: I've attached our redlines; the success metric clause is non-negotiable for us.

We can sign a pilot SOW by 6/11 if we get a final quote today. Would you be able to send an updated quote reflecting the conditional 20% and the proposed support add-on?

Thanks,
Anna Torres
VP, Product & Integrations
GreenBridge AI
(anna@greenbridge.ai)

Attachments: GreenBridge_SOW_v1_redlines.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance-team@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast stability advisory: pricing gate items needing commit

Team —

Consolidating for finance and the forecast call: GreenBridge is willing to accept 20% for a 6-month pilot conditional on dedicated ramp support and a post-pilot renewal review. They can sign by 6/11 if we get a final conditioned quote today.

Action items:
- Vanessa: please upload the AE's one-paragraph business impact into the pricing_approval_form.xlsx and confirm the support scope (due EOD).
- Karthik: please provisionally approve 20% off conditional on finance's revenue recognition guidance; if finance objects, we mark as 'at-risk' for Q3.
- Marissa / Finance: please confirm whether net-45 with an early-pay credit alters recognition timing materially (cc'd finance-team). If finance confirms recognition is OK, I'll mark this as commit for Q3; otherwise we'll flag as at-risk.

I've added the HubSpot link and the SOW to the file share — final quote should include the support add-on line and the renewal guardrail. If we can get approvals by close of business today, I'll include as committed in the forecast.

-Jordan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
